prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-21, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-21):
| Current ratio           | 1.52 |
| Retained earnings       | 45,920M |
| Current liabilities     | 6,324M |
| Current assets          | 9,606M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 51,071M |
| Total liabilities       | 28,826M |
| Total assets            | 79,897M |
| EBIT / operating income | 1,154M |
| Revenue                 | 6,053M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company exhibits solid leverage with total liabilities well-covered by assets and a strong equity base (debt ~36% of assets; EBIT-to-liabilities supportive), along with a comfortable current ratio. While profitability is decent (EBIT ~19% of revenue), limited liquidity indicators are available beyond the current ratio. Overall, the credit profile is consistent with a solid investment-grade rating, albeit not at the very top, given moderate liquidity cushions and no explicit cash-flow data.

DECISION: A-
